articles.title: Jim Cramer says Dell’s blowout quarter sets up a crucial week for AI stocks
articles.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said Dell Technologies’ blockbuster quarter reignited enthusiasm around AI and data center stocks.

articles.title: Dell stock skyrockets 32% for its best day ever as AI server revenue soars
articles.description: Dell reported its fastest pace of revenue growth since returning to the public market in 2018, with AI server revenue soaring 757% over last year.

articles.title: Michael Dell courted Trump early. His company has reaped rewards
articles.description: The dynamic is emblematic of how business is seeking to sow favor with the president in his second term, and has departed from the norms of big business philanthropy.
